_description: Long single-paper scenario: ontology exceeding the 8000-char context budget. Tests that V1 (which has no budget cap on hardcoded content) and V2 (with truncation warning) both produce deterministic, valid prompts.
_scenario_notes: Many entity types + verbose descriptions to exceed ONTOLOGY_CONTEXT_BUDGET_CHARS=8000. Verifies V2 truncation path while V1 just embeds everything.

entity_types.name: UO2Fuel
entity_types.description: Standard uranium dioxide fuel used in LWR. Detailed microstructure evolution under irradiation. Thermal conductivity degrades with burnup due to point defect accumulation and fission product precipitation.

entity_types.name: MOXFuel
entity_types.description: Mixed oxide fuel (UO2+PuO2). Higher heavy metal loading, distinct fission gas behavior.

entity_types.name: ZrAlloyCladding
entity_types.description: Zircaloy-4 and related alloys for fuel cladding. Critical for corrosion resistance and creep behavior under irradiation.

entity_types.name: SiCComposite
entity_types.description: Silicon carbide fiber-reinforced SiC matrix composite for advanced reactor cladding.

entity_types.name: FerriticSteel
entity_types.description: Ferritic/martensitic steels (HT9, T91) for fast reactor cladding and wrapper.

entity_types.name: AusteniticSteel
entity_types.description: Type 316 and 304 stainless steels. Historically used for fast reactor cladding.

entity_types.name: Graphite
entity_types.description: Nuclear grade graphite for moderator and reflector in HTGR.

entity_types.name: MoltenSalt
entity_types.description: FLiBe and similar fluoride salts for molten salt reactors.

entity_types.name: LeadBismuth
entity_types.description: Lead-bismuth eutectic coolant for fast reactors.
